using namespace std;

void solve() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    string res;
    int n = s.length();
    bool at_replaced = false;
    enum State { NORMAL, SEEN_A, SEEN_D, SEEN_DO };
    State state = NORMAL;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        switch (state) {
            case NORMAL:
                if (i == 0) {
                    res += c;
                    break;
                }
                if (!at_replaced && c == 'a' && i <= n-3) {
                    state = SEEN_A;
                } else if (c == 'd' && i <= n-4) {
                    state = SEEN_D;
                } else {
                    res += c;
                }
                break;
            case SEEN_A:
                if (c == 't' && !at_replaced) {
                    res += '@';
                    at_replaced = true;
                    state = NORMAL;
                } else {
                    res += 'a';
                    res += c;
                    state = NORMAL;
                }
                break;
            case SEEN_D:
                if (c == 'o') {
                    state = SEEN_DO;
                } else {
                    res += 'd';
                    res += c;
                    state = NORMAL;
                }
                break;
            case SEEN_DO:
                if (c == 't') {
                    res += '.';
                    state = NORMAL;
                } else {
                    res += 'd';
                    res += 'o';
                    res += c;
                    state = NORMAL;
                }
                break;
        }
    }
    cout << res;
}

int main() {
    #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE

    freopen("op.txt", "w", stdout);

void rec(int i, const string& s, string& res, bool& at_replaced) {
    int n = s.length();
    if (i >= n) return;
    if (i == 0) {
        res += s[i];
        rec(i+1, s, res, at_replaced);
        return;
    }
    // Check "at" replacement
    if (!at_replaced && i <= n-3 && i+1 < n && s[i]=='a' && s[i+1]=='t') {
        res += '@';
        at_replaced = true;
        rec(i+2, s, res, at_replaced);
        return;
    }
    // Check "dot" replacement
    if (i <= n-4 && i+2 < n && s[i]=='d' && s[i+1]=='o' && s[i+2]=='t') {
        res += '.';
        rec(i+3, s, res, at_replaced);
        return;
    }
    res += s[i];
    rec(i+1, s, res, at_replaced);
}

void solve() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    string res;
    bool at_replaced = false;
    rec(0, s, res, at_replaced);
    cout << res;
}

int main() {
    #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE

    freopen("op.txt", "w", stdout);
    #endif
    ios::sync_with_stdio(0); cin.tie(0); cout.tie(0);

    return 0;
}

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

void solve() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    string res;
    int n = s.length();
    bool at_replaced = false;
    int cur = 0;
    while (cur < n) {
        if (cur == 0) {
            res += s[cur];
            cur++;
            continue;
        }
        // Find next "at" or "dot" starting from cur, but only within allowed bounds
        int next_at = -1, next_dot = -1;
        // Search for "at" from cur to n-3
        for (int j = cur; j <= n-3 && j+1 < n; ++j) {
            if (!at_replaced && s[j]=='a' && s[j+1]=='t') {
                next_at = j;
                break;
            }
        }
        // Search for "dot" from cur to n-4
        for (int j = cur; j <= n-4 && j+2 < n; ++j) {
            if (s[j]=='d' && s[j+1]=='o' && s[j+2]=='t') {
                next_dot = j;
                break;
            }
        }
        // Choose the earliest occurrence
        int next = -1;
        bool is_at = false;
        if (next_at != -1 && (next_dot == -1 || next_at < next_dot)) {
            next = next_at;
            is_at = true;
        } else if (next_dot != -1) {
            next = next_dot;
            is_at = false;
        }
        if (next == -1) {
            // No more patterns, copy rest
            res += s.substr(cur);
            break;
        }
        // Copy characters from cur to next-1
        res += s.substr(cur, next - cur);
        if (is_at) {
            res += '@';
            at_replaced = true;
            cur = next + 2;
        } else {
            res += '.';
            cur = next + 3;
        }
    }
    cout << res;
}

int main() {
    #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("in.txt", "r", stdin);
    freopen("op.txt", "w", stdout);
    #endif
    ios::sync_with_stdio(0); cin.tie(0); cout.tie(0);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
